# Auctaryn

> Auctaryn adds context-integrity checks and advisory risk assessments to supported autonomous-agent paths. Tinlance Agent Platform remains authoritative for identity, tenant binding, policy, approvals, governed execution, secrets, and audit.

Auctaryn is defense-in-depth software, not a universal agent-action interceptor or a replacement for a trusted runtime.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): overview, safe local evaluation, configuration, boundaries.
- [Implementation roadmap](docs/IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md): phase sequence and acceptance gates.

- [Security risk register](docs/SECURITY_RISK_REGISTER.md): known risks and mitigations.
- [Platform integration contract](docs/integration/TINLANCE_AGENT_PLATFORM.md): advisory contract and authority separation.

## Limitations

- Risk assessment is advisory; it does not grant permission, approve actions, or execute tools.
- `runtime_observed: false` must remain explicit when the classifier only has caller-supplied metadata.
- Local evidence storage is not the Tinlance Agent Platform audit system of record.
- A verified trusted runtime integration and Platform-side conformance tests are required before production-integration claims.
- CI success alone is not a security certification.
